run_completion: run the completion function to generate text from a model using messages and optional params
build_prompt_custom: build a prompt using custom_prompt with role dict, initial and final prompt values, and messages
build_prompt_standard: build a prompt using prompt_factory with a model name and list of messages
run_completion_api_base: run the completion function with an api_base to post requests via httpx to a remote endpoint
run_completion_local: run the completion function without api_base to generate locally via AutoDistributedModelForCausalLM
